notes: State rows: stateRate, avgLocalRate (population-weighted), localRateMax and combinedAvgRate from Tax Foundation 'State and Local Sales Tax Rates as of January 1, 2026' (taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/sales-tax-rates/). The /2026-sales-tax-rates/ URL now serves the July 1, 2026 midyear table, stored under midyear2026.
stateRate cross-checked on official revenue sites for TX, TN, MO, SD, DC, NC, AZ, CA, NY, WA, FL (stateRateOfficialChecked=true); all match Tax Foundation.
avgLocalRate, localRateMin and localRateMax are estimates (Tax Foundation). localRateMin is 0 where some areas levy no local tax; TF does not publish a minimum.
No state changed its general state rate between 2026-01-01 and 2026-10-12 per Tax Foundation midyear and Vertex mid-year report; DC rose to 7.0% on 2026-10-01 and Guam BPT fell to 4.0% on 2026-10-01.

Samples are combined rates for the city's principal rate area as of early 2026; estimate=true means secondary vendor source (Avalara, Sales Tax Handbook, Kintsugi, Stripe, TaxCloud) rather than an official rate table. Rates vary by address within cities.
censusPlaceGeoid from Census 2024 Gazetteer place file; null where not matched.
Territory rows: PR IVU 11.5% total (10.5% + 1% municipal), GU 4.5% BPT on gross receipts, VI 5% gross receipts tax, AS no sales tax (8% import excise), MP no sales tax (graduated BGRT 1.5-5%).
